title: discoveryrule.get
description: Retrieve LLD rules according to the given parameters.

itemids.description: Return only LLD rules with the given IDs.

groupids.description: Return only LLD rules that belong to the hosts from the given groups.

hostids.description: Return only LLD rules that belong to the given hosts.

inherited.description: If set to true return only LLD rules inherited from a template.

interfaceids.description: Return only LLD rules use the given host interfaces.

monitored.description: If set to true return only enabled LLD rules that belong to monitored hosts.

templated.description: If set to true return only LLD rules that belong to templates.

templateids.description: Return only LLD rules that belong to the given templates.

selectFilter.description: Return a filter property with data of the filter used by the LLD rule.

selectGraphs.description: Returns a graphs property with graph prototypes that belong to the LLD rule. Supports count.

selectHostPrototypes.description: Return a hostPrototypes property with host prototypes that belong to the LLD rule. Supports count.

selectHosts.description: Return a hosts property with an array of hosts that the LLD rule belongs to.

selectItems.description: Return an items property with item prototypes that belong to the LLD rule. Supports count.

selectTriggers.description: Return a triggers property with trigger prototypes that belong to the LLD rule. Supports count.

selectLLDMacroPaths.description: Return an lld_macro_paths property with a list of LLD macros and paths to values assigned to each corresponding macro.

selectPreprocessing.description: Return a preprocessing property with LLD rule preprocessing options.

selectOverrides.description: Return an lld_rule_overrides property with a list of override filters, conditions and operations that are performed on prototype objects.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against. Does not support properties of text data type. Supports an additional property: host - technical name of the host that the LLD rule belongs to.

limitSelects.description: Limits the number of records returned by subselects. Applies to the following subselects: selectItems, selectGraphs, selectTriggers.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: itemid, name, key_, delay, type, status.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
